CLM-MAT-0332.statement: Compacting the GO_300 ºC_S3 sample under a load of 10 tons increases its thermal conductivity by approximately 37% near 100 K.

extra_quotes: The thermal conductivity was measured by a steady-state uniaxial heat-flow technique in the temperature range 4.5 –100 K using a specially designed cryogenic apparatus [23].

The overall uncertainty of the thermal conductivity measurements did not exceed 15%, including approximately 5% associated with the uncertainty in thermocouple spacing, whereas the reproducibility of the experimental data was better than ±2%.
